clarity_hierarchy.critique: The visual hierarchy is fractured by a lack of clear grouping between the central title and the mission briefing. The briefing box floats in isolation, creating a 'dead zone' of negative space between the title and the call-to-action (CTA). The CTA ('INITIALIZE DEFENSE') suffers from low contrast and visual weight; its thin outline style makes it compete poorly against the glowing title and the dense upgrade cards at the bottom. The upgrade cards at the bottom are visually heavy and distract from the primary goal of starting the game. The HUD elements at the top are disconnected from the main content, creating a disjointed reading flow.

visual_system_craft.critique: The visual system suffers from a lack of geometric consistency and component cohesion. The 'Initialize Defense' button uses a disjointed, broken-line border style that clashes with the solid, filled containers of the upgrade cards and the briefing panel. The HUD elements (Wave, Credits) lack a unified container or background, making them feel like floating text rather than a cohesive interface. The upgrade cards at the bottom have inconsistent internal spacing and typography hierarchy; the 'Level' text is too small and lacks contrast against the dark background. The orbital ring graphic cuts awkwardly through the UI elements without a clear layering strategy, creating visual clutter rather than depth. The color palette is functional but lacks a defined hierarchy; the cyan is used for everything from critical alerts to decorative lines, diluting its semantic meaning.
visual_system_craft.suggestion: Establish a strict geometric language: choose either sharp, military-style right angles or rounded, futuristic curves and apply them consistently to all containers, buttons, and progress bars. Unify the HUD by placing the top-left and top-right stats inside matching semi-transparent panels with consistent padding and borders. Redesign the 'Initialize Defense' button to match the visual weight of the upgrade cards—perhaps using a solid background with a border, or a consistent stroke style across all interactive elements. Refine the upgrade cards by standardizing the icon-to-text spacing and increasing the contrast of the 'Level' indicators. Introduce a subtle gradient or glass-morphism effect to the panels to separate them from the background planet, ensuring the text remains legible. Finally, define a clear z-index hierarchy so the orbital ring sits distinctly behind or in front of UI elements, rather than intersecting them ambiguously.
